title: Bongo Bananacorno
premise: Bongo bites one oversized banana-corn hybrid, loses it into the smiley bucket, slams the bucket once, and triggers a banana-popcorn eruption.

dialogue.delivery: dry, pleased, same voice and pitch

shots.action: Bongo bites the oversized banana-corn hybrid; his tooth pings; the complete object springs free and visibly falls into the bucket.
Bongo crouches, raises both arms and performs one forceful double-palm bucket slam with contact, compression, recoil and settle.
A short suspense beat becomes a continuous banana-popcorn eruption that buries Bongo; he emerges and tastes one piece.

generation_policy.acceptance_rule: Accept only real in-between motion with readable cause and effect; do not rescue pose dissolves as final motion.
